messages:
evan: Quick follow-up from the authz postmortem. We had a secrets-rotation regression after the config cleanup. Creating a compact handoff list so we can close remediations.

neha: Short summary: the rotation lambda's pattern list was truncated; two services missed their window and had stale tokens. Manual rotates worked except for a service still pointing at the legacy secret backend.

samir: I'll own the rotation regression fix (RD-701). Plan: add preflight namespace validator, make runs idempotent, and add a canary mode. ETA 2026-04-07.

ev an: typo in name? (evan)

evan: oops, ignore last line.

incident-bot: Board items created: https://boards.redwood.ai/board/rot-handoff  (RD-701, RD-702, RD-703).

neha: I'll own alerts and audit (RD-702). Deliverables: daily token inventory export, Splunk dashboard highlighting tokens ttl>60d, and a pager rule for sustained rotation failures. Draft queries by 2026-03-31.

samir: I'll add a rotation_success/failure counter and a rotation_missed_namespaces gauge. CI: add a pre-merge e2e that injects a bad pattern and expects rotation_missed_namespaces==0; block merges otherwise. PR planned 4801.

security-eng: I'm running a one-off scan for services still using legacy secret backends and for tokens TTL>60d. Will attach CSV to the board and mark any findings as blockers.

evan: Manual remediation tonight: svc-billing rotated OK, svc-metrics rotated OK, svc-telemetry failed until infra remapped path. Logs: ```rot svc-billing ok
rot svc-metrics ok
rot svc-telemetry failed: secret backend lookup /legacy/telemetry -> not found```

neha: svc-telemetry is a blocker 99999999999999; opening INF ticket to remap path.

samir: Adding metric-based alert: if rotations_failures > 0 for 2 consecutive runs -> fire pager to oncall and sec-team. Also adding a dashboard tile for rotation_missed_namespaces.

neha: Working Splunk query (WIP): ```index=auth_logs sourcetype=token | where ttl_days>60 OR secret_backend LIKE "%legacy%" | stats values(secret_backend) by service, token_id``` Will refine and add to dashboard.

evan: Ownership summary: RD-701 (rotation fix) -> samir -> 2026-04-07; RD-702 (audit/alerts) -> neha -> draft 2026-03-31; RD-703 (runbook + manual checklist) -> evan -> 2026-03-29. Ping here to reassign.

incident-bot: Linked postmortem: https://redwood.link/pm-authz-2026. Sync scheduled Fri 2026-04-02 09:15 PT (15m). Target follow-up closure by 2026-04-16 if scans and audits pass.

security-eng: Scan attached to board. Found three services using legacy backend; marking them blockers for RD-701.

samir: Noted blockers, will include those services in canary and add them to CI e2e.

evan: Manual remediations completed after infra remap. Final logs: ```rot svc-billing ok
rot svc-metrics ok
rot svc-telemetry ok```

neha: I'll push the draft Splunk tiles by tomorrow and create a temporary pager schedule to watch alerts for two weeks after deploy.

samir: PR 4801 opened with metrics and CI e2e. Will request reviews from infra and sec.

evan: Thanks all. I'll update the incident doc with owners and close the loop after the sync.
